chunks: Ahmad ibn Ziyad al-Hamadani (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated to us from his father, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him). He said:
When Allah, Mighty and Majestic, decides to resurrect the creation, He will cause the sky to rain upon the earth for forty mornings, and then the bones will reassemble and the flesh will grow.

key_terms.الأوصال: Bones, joints, skeletal remains - referring to the decomposed body
key_terms.اللحوم: Flesh, meat - referring to the physical body that will be restored
key_terms.يبعث الخلق: Resurrect the creation - bodily resurrection on the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: How does Shia Islam describe the process of bodily resurrection?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) describes the mechanism of bodily resurrection: God will send rain upon the earth for forty mornings, causing the scattered bones to reassemble and flesh to regrow. This teaching addressed the skeptics of resurrection who questioned how decomposed bodies could be restored, a topic also addressed in several Quranic passages (e.g., 36:78-79, 75:3-4). The imagery of rain as a life-giving force mirrors the Quran's use of rain as a metaphor for resurrection (22:5).
